Bug_Title: "volatile" variables should not be used with compound operators
Bug_Explanation: By using compound operator on a volatile variable, it may lead to inconsistency due to the non-atomic nature of these operations. The incrementAndGet() and set() methods provided by AtomicInteger and AtomicBoolean ensure that these operations are atomic.
